sources.note: Official documentation describes the Opentrons Thermocycler Module as a fully automated on-deck thermocycler.
Official product page confirms Opentrons Thermocycler Module GEN2 identity and branding.

applied_updates.name: Opentrons ATC 自动热循环仪
applied_updates.description: 用于PCR等核酸扩增流程的自动热循环仪模块，提供程序化温度循环并配备可开合加热上盖。
applied_updates.description_en: Automated thermocycler module for PCR workflows with programmed temperature cycling and an opening heated lid.
